title: Build the 40-point phone composer buttons in the fix-up, and narrow the Tab-reach loosening
context: Lane 5 could not build the spec's 40-point Back and Save on the phone composer, because they live in text_composer_sheet.dart, which no Step's write-set held. The wider full-screen composer also leaves a 3.4-point sliver of the format bar's Quote button that the Tab-reach helper treats as an unreachable target. The Worker proposed letting any stop whose rect contains a target's centre count as reaching it.
options: Leave the 40-point buttons for a follow-up PR
Build them in a named fix-up commit on the shell branch with a red-then-green test
Apply the Worker's symmetric containment check to every stop
Apply symmetric containment only to non-editable stops, so a large editor rect cannot mask an unreachable control inside it
outcome: I built the 40-point buttons in fix-up commit 44b10192, phone only. Exit pill and Save are 40 tall, and Save has horizontal padding 14, radius 12 and 12-point text. The header geometry is unchanged and macOS is untouched. The new test was red at 34 and is green now. For Tab reach, I chose the non-editable-only loosening (commit b5c27d91). It fixes the clipped-sliver case and keeps photo controls inside the editor honest. Every tab_reach user passes.
